candidate_units.scope: Add docs/release/ovd-520-same-run-proof.sql: staged, synthetic only, run after the OVD-563 proof inside the same rolled-back fixture transaction. Add a '--ovd520' branch to scripts/ovd510-disposable-replay.mjs, modelled on the --ovd563 block near lines 715-740, with an exact pinned assertion count. The proof must: (1) as owner n(1), call api_submit_engineering_message('Set depth to 7 mm') on the baseline snapshot; (2) as service, call api_resolve_engineering_request(prepared_change, 7) with provenance; (3) insert runtime and input admissions as the database owner, labelled simulated; (4) claim via api_claim_native_task; (5) record a simulated qualified stop; (6) register the seven objects; (7) sign a v2 receipt and call engineering_private.finalize_native_result; (8) call associate_native_step_review; (9) as the owner, read api_read_native_step_review. open_questions.question: How should the phone reach /engineering for the OVD-520 run?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Today /engineering only loads on loopback with the dev flag and is left out of production builds, so OVD-520's cross-device acceptance cannot be met without a decision.
open_questions.options: (a) A private Tailscale Serve route for /engineering, like OVD-579, with the host gate relaxed to the tailnet host. (b) A hosted production deployment behind a flag and allowlist (protected). (c) The iOS app (Lane B design).

open_questions.question: Which backend should the run use: hosted Supabase production, or a private Supabase on Workstation behind Tailscale?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Decides which protected migration, credential and principal steps are needed, and whether production data is touched at all.
open_questions.options: Hosted production (apply the 10 active engineering migrations plus staged 558/560/561/563 and any SQL from PR #565, after a manifest refresh), or a self-hosted private stack.

open_questions.question: Which interpretation adapter should the run use?
open_questions.why_it_matters: engineering-interpretation has no adapter and refuses even when enabled. The docs name gpt-5.4, OVD-578 used Jev 1.13.0, and PR #565 adds a prepared Jev adapter.
open_questions.options: A deterministic classifier-only adapter (no model call, $0), Jev 1.13.0 through a server-side credential, or gpt-5.4. The budget reserve is 20 cents per request, capped at 4000 cents a month.

open_questions.question: What should happen to draft PR #565 (97 files, +7779 lines, CI red)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It holds the only server pieces for steps 6 and 9-11 (input mapping, artifact route, result admission, finalize, replay). It says it is preservation-only, and its test job has a one-line fix that I reproduced.
open_questions.options: (a) Fix CI (P1, P2, Sonar) and land it whole. (b) Split it into bounded, reviewable PRs per contract. (c) Keep it as reference only and rebuild the pieces.

open_questions.question: How should OVD-520's no-automatic-retry rule be enforced and documented?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The database still allows one automatic retry for native_startup_timeout, and three docs still specify one retry.
open_questions.options: (a) Rely on the worker route never exposing a retry action, and pin that with tests (A4, A5). (b) Also revoke or disable api_request_native_retry for this pilot. (c) Update engineering-automatic-loop.md, engineering-task-coordinator.md and engineering-control-plane.md to state the OVD-520 exception.

open_questions.question: May the SolidWorks session that OVD-578 keeps open be closed for the OVD-520 run?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The prepared runner aborts if any SLDWORKS process exists (run.ps1:245), while the OVD-578 rules say never to kill its session.
open_questions.options: Close it manually before the run, or schedule the OVD-520 run when no sample-plate session is active.

open_questions.question: Should OVD-511 be closed or re-scoped?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It is Backlog and formally blocks OVD-520, while its children OVD-560 and 561 are Done.
open_questions.options: Close it with evidence links, or keep it open for the protected production finalization activation.

open_questions.question: Should the UI label each result as simulation, retained replay or new native output?

notes:
12-step flow mapped to source and evidence level. Levels: none / source + inert tests / DB tests / native-historical. CI = observed passing on main CI run 36828979472 at 8d8d243.
1. Exact context binding. Source: supabase/migrations/20260910045917_engineering_durable_inbox.sql (api_submit_engineering_message: input snapshot, expected revision, idempotency key), src/features/engineering/engineering-inbox-client.ts, src/pages/EngineeringInbox.tsx. Level: DB tests (supabase/tests/engineering_inbox.sql in CI; scripts/test-engineering-inbox.mjs is manual) plus fixture browser tests.
2. Bounded intent. Source: server/engineering/interpret-prepared-request.ts, dispatch-prepared-request.ts, supabase/functions/engineering-interpretation (default-off, no adapter), migration 20260927060736. Level: DB tests (engineering_interpretation_reservations.sql in CI; ovd518-race-proof manual). No live adapter and no trigger.
3. Persist request and interpretation, idempotent. Source: 20260910045917 and 20260910055556 (api_resolve_engineering_request). Level: DB tests (engineering_inbox.sql and engineering_ordered_changes.sql in CI).
4. Ordered task admission, failure blocks successors. Source: 20260910055556 and 20260910104500 (verified_predecessor_required); staged ovd-561 releases only the immediate successor. Level: DB tests (CI for active migrations; ovd-561 proof and race proof manual).
5. Paired companion claim with fence. Source: 20260910064137, 20260910104500 (fence = slot.fence+1), supabase/functions/engineering-worker and engineering-worker-task, scripts/native/worker-companion/run-task.ps1, CompanionTask.ps1, CompanionTaskHttp.ps1. Level: DB tests plus inert Windows (companion-task.yml last passed on main at eeb71543). No live pairing.
6. Immutable input download with digest. Source: CompanionArtifact.ps1 and server/engineering/native-artifact-transport.ts (no production adapter); the concrete route and mapping are only in PR #565. Level: source + inert tests.
7. Single native execution. Source: scripts/native/prepared-dimension/run.ps1, WireContract.ps1, file-admission, attempt-journal; native_slots. Level: native-historical, and only from the operator lane, never companion-dispatched (OVD-509 at a938fb83/89580031/a0e133b4; OVD-495 at e3264e16).
8. Stop observation through the restricted observer. Source: scripts/native/stop-observer, migrations 20260927130000/20260927140000/20260927225843, native-stop-transport.ts, native-stop-repository.ts, engineering-worker-stop. Level: DB tests (manual docker runners) plus inert Windows. The observer profile is not native-qualified.
9. Immutable output upload and registration. Source: CompanionArtifact.ps1 spool, native-result-registration.ts, staged ovd-560 SQL. Level: source + inert tests plus a staged DB proof (manual, 11 assertions pinned).
10. Independent verifier. Source: native-result-receipt.ts, native-result-bytes.ts, native-reports.ts, staged OVD-558 authority SQL. Level: source + inert tests; no service, no key.
11. Atomic, replay-safe finalization. Source: staged ovd-561 SQL plus scripts/ovd561-race-proof.mjs; the TypeScript executor and replay are only in PR #565. Level: staged DB tests (manual, 24 pinned).
12. Authenticated same-run STEP retrieval. Source: staged ovd-563 SQL, server/engineering/native-step-review.ts, src/features/engineering/exact-step-review.ts, EngineeringStepReview.tsx. Level: staged DB tests (manual, 21 pinned) plus fixture browser tests (CI). The UI never checks the attempt, and a phone cannot reach the route.

B. Workstation. x64 Windows PowerShell 5.1 build; SolidWorks 2022 SP5 30.5.0.0049 at C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS 2022\SOLIDWORKS\SLDWORKS.exe; zero existing SLDWORKS processes (run.ps1:245); a standalone Roslyn csc.exe; output of prepare-runtime.ps1 -Prepare with the profile path and SHA-256; X1 receipts.

D. Database. Target decision; the 10 active engineering migrations; staged 558, 560, 561, 563 and any PR #565 SQL, with a refreshed OVD-558 manifest (engineering-inbox.md:106-113); the reverse scripts, which refuse to drop populated history; the index-build write-lock note (engineering-change-queue.md:318-324).
E. Principals and secrets. An engineering_operators allowlist row for Blaine's user and org; the project, conversation and baseline snapshot (no UI creates them; engineering-inbox.md:148); a worker row with an odp_ pairing code (10 minutes) and a DPAPI token store; Edge SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY; ENGINEERING_STOP_EXECUTOR_URL and TOKEN for the ovd576_stop_validator role; the OVD-575 validator attribution user; the receipt HMAC key in engineering_private.native_receipt_key; the verifier JWT issuer and claims; a private Storage bucket, its authorization and versionId qualification; any model credential.

Runtime admission (installation, job schema v2, source/executable/interop/compiler digests, qualification-evidence digest); seed input admission (qualified import); the OVD-576 prepared/native qualification row for the observer profile; owner session enablement via api_control_worker_session.
G. Flags and routes. ENGINEERING_WORKER_GATEWAY_ENABLED, ENGINEERING_WORKER_TASK_ENABLED, ENGINEERING_WORKER_STOP_ENABLED and ENGINEERING_INTERPRETATION_ENABLED all set to exactly true; verify_jwt=false only for the worker routes; the artifact route at /functions/v1/engineering-worker-artifact (PR #565); the chosen phone route; spending caps of $40/month AI and $10/month platform.
H. Run procedure. The phone sends 'Set depth to 7 mm' and gets a receipt; interpretation is triggered; the owner enables the boot; run-task.ps1 -Connect -ExecuteOne with WorkerId, GatewayUrl, TaskId, RuntimeAdmissionId, InputAdmissionId, TaskRevision, InputArtifactIds (3), PackageRoot, OutputRoot, SourceCommit, RuntimeProfilePath and RuntimeProfileSha256; observer manifest to validator evidence ID to the stop endpoint; replay-output.ps1 sends the seven outputs; admitResult; finalize; STEP association; phone review; the browser is closed mid-run and reopened.
I. Evidence to capture. Conversation, message and request IDs; interpretation ID; decision and task IDs; attempt ID and fence; journal and observer manifest SHA-256; all seven check results; the seven registered object digests; receipt payload SHA-256 and signature; finalization ID; candidate snapshot and context SHA-256; STEP SHA-256; source and companion hashes unchanged; final SolidWorks process inventory; a recording labelled simulation vs replay vs native.
J. Rollback. Turn the flags off, let the active job drain, keep every record, never kill unrelated SolidWorks processes. An uncertain outcome goes to recovery_required with no rerun.
